full_judgment: "The learned Advocate for the accused petitioner argued that after acceptance of Income Tax return for the year 2006-2007 the matter relating to wealth cannot be reopened by the Anti-Corruption Commission. But it appears from the sections 26 and 27 of the Anti-Corruption Commission Act that the Commission is given authority to take decision regarding concealment of assets and identify properties disproportionate to known source of income independently. Income Tax return does not create any legal bar to bring allegations and the accused-petitioner shall get scope to rebut presumption as to correctness of the allegation before the Court under section 27(2) of the Anti-Corruption Commission Act, 2004."
